final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), gt AS (SELECT g.fundflux, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM gt) SELECT gt.fundflux, gt.cnt, gt.ratio, gt.cnt - a.avgcnt AS diff FROM gt JOIN a ON a.avgcnt IS NOT NULL WHERE gt.cnt > a.avgcnt
